description: Port congestion from labour disputes caused 3-week container dwell times
root_cause: Labour action combined with vessel scheduling failures at Port of Singapore
lessons_learned: Need real-time port visibility; consider port insurance or cost-pass clauses
assumptions_wrong: Assumed port operates at 85-90% capacity; Actual: 50-60%; Assumed 30-day lead times; Actual: 52-day dwell

description: Defective component batch from new production line affected 2500 finished goods units
root_cause: Quality control gaps in supplier new line; insufficient audits of expansion
assumptions_wrong: Tighten supplier audits; add certification requirements
status: Assumed ISO 9001 meant zero defects; Actual: 2.5% defect rate

description: Peak season carrier capacity shortage led to rate hikes and spot market exposure
root_cause: Unexpected vessel breakdown cascade across carrier fleet during August peak
lessons_learned: Diversify carriers; negotiate long-term rate protection
assumptions_wrong: Assumed carriers maintain 15% buffer; Actual: no buffer during peak
